QUOTE: "`mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` with its own functions."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names memory_buffer_alloc.c's init function as installing its own allocator through the runtime setter. It does not say outright that this is the only in-tree user, but "The library ships `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c`... calls the setter" is the substance of the item.
